text: There seems to be a significant discrepancy; the lab results clearly indicate Glanzmann's thrombasthenia based on the GIIb/IIIa receptor deficiency, not pneumonia. Can you confirm if you have any shortness of breath or fever, or are these symptoms unrelated to the bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.
